meta.name: verify-unattended
meta.description: Install, instrument and verify a web app end to end without pausing for a human. Use in an autonomous or goal-mode agent, in CI, or in any client that asks for approval on every command: it never says "restart your client" or "open a browser", because it takes a route that needs neither. Prefer the normal install-and-verify skill when a human is present and can answer.

copy.tagline: 无需人工确认即可装好并验证网页应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用自动化代理或 CI 跑任务,却总被要求逐条确认命令。
copy.tagline_en: Install and verify a web app end to end with no human approval
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent or CI must set up and verify an app with no one to approve commands

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自动把 Reticle 接入项目、启动开发服务器、连接页面并驱动应用做端到端验证,最后给出 verified 为 yes/no/unknown 的结论,过程中不要求重启客户端或打开浏览器,也不向人提问。
howto.when: 当你在自主或 goal 模式 agent、CI,或每条命令都需人工批准的客户端里跑 web 应用装验时接管;有真人在场可用时,原文建议改用普通的 install-and-verify。

say.text: 把这个 web 应用装好并端到端验证一遍,中途不要停下来问我
say.note: 它会跑 init、启动服务、连接页面并给出结论

say.text: 验证点击退款后服务端返回 200,且响应体里含 refunded
say.note: 它会先声明预期结果,再动作并回读结论

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude wires Reticle into the project, starts the dev server, connects a page and drives the app to a verdict of verified yes, no or unknown — without asking, restarting the client or opening a browser.
howto.when_en: Use in an autonomous or goal-mode agent, in CI, or in any client that asks approval on every command. With a human present who can answer, the plain install-and-verify skill is preferred.

say_en.text: Install and verify this web app end to end, and don't stop to ask me
say_en.note: It runs init, starts the server, connects a page and reports a verdict

say_en.text: There is no session — acquire a lease yourself on http://localhost:3000/
say_en.note: Reticle opens a browser it owns and drives the page

say_en.text: Verify that clicking refund returns 200 with refunded in the response body
say_en.note: It declares the expected result first, then reads the verdict
